records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the London Fire Brigade dataset 'Shut in lift releases (lift entrapments) attended by LFB'. It is a complete list for the specified period, covers August 2023 through July 2026, is updated monthly, and supplies incident location information including postcode, borough and ward. The dataset is licensed under Open Government Licence v2. This batch binds verified Campden ward code E05009390 to that unused official ward-bearing dataset window without claiming extracted incident rows, geometry, parcel joins, or materialized parcel progress.
